p: this side Jordan by Jericho: Being at Jericho, it was beyond the Jordan, but where the Israelites were, it was on this side.
elders of Midian: Who were the heads and governors.
river of the land of the: That is, Euphrates, upon which stood this city Pethor.
the rewards of divination in their: Thinking to bribe him with gifts to curse the Israelites.
the princes of Moab abode with: Whom before he called elders: meaning the governors, and later calls them servants: that is, subjects to their king.
said unto Balaam: He warned him by a dream, that he should not consent to the kings wicked request.
me leave to go with you: Or else he would have been willing, covetousness had so blinded his heart.
Let nothing: The wicked seek by all means to further their naughty enterprises, though they know that God is against them.
more: Because he tempted God to require him contrary to his commandment, his petition was granted, but it turned to his own condemnation.
went: Moved rather with covetousness than to obey God.
But the angel of the LORD: The second time.
opened the mouth of the ass: Gave her power to speak.
since I was thine unto this: Since you have been my master.
opened the eyes of Balaam: For if the Lord does not open your eyes, you can see neither his anger or his love.
way is perverse before me: Both your heart is corrupt and your enterprise wicked.
word that I shall speak unto: Because his heart was evil, his charge was renewed, that he should not pretend ignorance.
border of Arnon: Near the place where the Israelites camped.
any thing: On my own I can say nothing, I will only speak what God reveals, whether it is good or bad.
Baal: Where the idol Baal was worshipped.
